methods.name: search_knowledge
methods.description:
Search the NEXUS knowledge base for study guide concepts,
architecture decisions, tech stack details, and agent descriptions.
Use this when you need context about the NEXUS project during a build session.

params.description: Number of results to return (default 5, max 10)
params.name: limit

returns.description: JSON array of matching knowledge records with relevance scores

methods.name: get_sprint_status
methods.description:
Get current sprint items and their completion status.
Use this to check what has been built, what is in progress, and what is pending.

params.description: Sprint number to filter by. Omit to get all sprints.
params.name: sprint_number

params.description: Filter by status: todo, in_progress, or done. Omit for all.
params.name: status

returns.description: JSON array of sprint items ordered by sprint number and priority
